```yaml
name: Auto-Assign Milestone

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  auto-assign-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine Milestone
        id: determine-milestone
        run: |
          TARGET_BRANCH="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}"
          MILESTONE=""

          if [[ "$TARGET_BRANCH" == "main" ]]; then
            # For main, we assign the next development milestone.
            # Based on the request, PRs to main get '9.5'.
            # In a dynamic scenario, this would calculate the next version.
            # Here we follow the specific rule: main -> 9.5
            MILESTONE="9.5"
          elif [[ "$TARGET_BRANCH" =~ ^release/([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)$ ]]; then
            # For release branches, e.g., release/9.4 -> 9.4.1
            VERSION="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            MILESTONE="${VERSION}.1"
          else
            # No milestone for other branches
            MILESTONE=""
          fi

          echo "milestone=${MILESTONE}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Assigned milestone: ${MILESTONE}"

      - name: Assign Milestone to PR
        if: steps.determine-milestone.outputs.milestone != ''
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const milestoneName = '${{ steps.determine-milestone.outputs.milestone }}';
            const prNumber = context.issue.number;

            // Fetch all milestones to find the ID for the name
            const milestones = await github.rest.issues.listMilestones({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'all'
            });

            const milestone = milestones.data.find(m => m.title === milestoneName);

            if (!milestone) {
              console.log(`Milestone "${milestoneName}" not found. Skipping assignment.`);
              return;
            }

            // Update the PR with the milestone
            await github.rest.pulls.update({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: prNumber,
              milestone: milestone.number
            });

            console.log(`Successfully assigned milestone "${milestoneName}" to PR #${prNumber}`);
```
